scene_description: Three young children wearing colorful ski gear and helmets are standing on a snowy ski slope with skis on their feet. An adult ski instructor wearing a white helmet and red jacket stands nearby watching them. The children appear to be in a ski lesson, with one child reaching out to touch another child's helmet. Mountains and ski lift cables are visible in the background.

questions.question: What are the children wearing on their heads?
questions.sentence_frame: They are wearing ___ on their heads.
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the top of each child's head.

questions.question: What are the children doing in this picture?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the children's feet and what is on the ground.

questions.question: Where are the children skiing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the ground and the background behind the children.

questions.question: What do you wear a helmet for?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the helmets on the children's heads and think about why people wear them.

questions.question: Who is the grown-up standing next to the children? Is she a teacher or a mom shopping?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the grown-up is wearing and where she is standing near the children.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever played in the snow? What did you do?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you were outside in the cold or snow.
